# Antbuildz AI

> Antbuildz AI helps industrial rental, equipment, parts, manufacturing and technical product businesses turn approved product knowledge into useful buyer conversations and qualified sales handovers.

Canonical website: https://antbuildz.ai

## Product model

- [AI Sales Agent](https://antbuildz.ai/ai-sales-agent): The core Antbuildz AI product. It qualifies industrial requirements, recommends supported options from approved knowledge, captures buyer intent and prepares human handovers.
- [AI Webstore Suite](https://antbuildz.ai/ai-webstore-suite): An optional supporting system for the AI Sales Agent. It adds structured product pages, dedicated product URLs and connected inventory context for more accurate recommendations, SEO and AI search discovery.
- [AI Agent Console](https://antbuildz.ai/ai-agent-console): Manages knowledge, instructions, testing, conversations, workflows and performance.
- [Pricing](https://antbuildz.ai/pricing): Current Antbuildz AI Sales Agent plans, Webstore options and included features.
- [Book a Demo](https://antbuildz.ai/book-a-demo): Share your name and work email, then choose and confirm a demo time in Calendly.

## Learning and support

- [Resources](https://antbuildz.ai/resources): Practical AI Sales Agent guides covering buyer conversations, approved knowledge, inventory connections, Webstore support, readiness and Console operations.
- [AI Agent Roles](https://antbuildz.ai/ai-roles): Industrial AI agent roles for sales, product recommendations, customer support, technical support and after-sales service. These are practical jobs for one grounded AI Agent, not separate subscriptions.
- [AI Agent for Sales](https://antbuildz.ai/ai-roles/sales-specialist): An industrial AI sales agent that answers product enquiries, guides product selection, captures buyer requirements and prepares qualified handovers for a sales team.
- [AI Agent for Product Guidance](https://antbuildz.ai/ai-roles/product-specialist): An AI product recommendation agent that helps buyers compare approved specifications, dimensions and product fit, while leaving uncertain compatibility checks with the team.
- [AI Agent for Customer Support](https://antbuildz.ai/ai-roles/customer-support): An AI customer support agent for delivery, returns and product enquiries using approved FAQs and policies, with handover for exceptions.
- [AI Agent for Technical Support](https://antbuildz.ai/ai-roles/technical-support): An AI technical support agent for equipment and industrial products that retrieves approved manuals, explains documented specifications and prepares specialist escalation.
- [AI Agent for After-Sales Service](https://antbuildz.ai/ai-roles/after-sales-service): An AI after-sales service agent for warranty, maintenance, repair and spare-parts enquiries, with service-team confirmation for coverage and compatibility.
- [Antbuildz AI Help Centre](https://antbuildz.ai/help/ai): AI-only product, knowledge, Webstore and onboarding answers.
- [About Antbuildz](https://antbuildz.ai/about): Company history, principles and industrial AI direction.
- [Antbuildz AI Agreements & Policies](https://antbuildz.ai/agreements): Legal terms and privacy information governing Antbuildz AI services.
- [Antbuildz AI Terms of Service](https://antbuildz.ai/agreements/terms): B2B terms for the AI Sales Agent, AI Webstore Suite and related Antbuildz AI services.
- [Antbuildz AI Privacy Policy](https://antbuildz.ai/agreements/privacy): How Antbuildz Pte. Ltd. handles personal data for Antbuildz.ai.
- [Antbuildz AI Data Processing Addendum](https://antbuildz.ai/agreements/dpa): Customer and Antbuildz data-processing responsibilities.
- [Antbuildz AI Acceptable Use Policy](https://antbuildz.ai/agreements/acceptable-use): Responsible platform use and safety-critical industrial boundaries. Cookie and analytics information is included in the Privacy Policy.

Antbuildz AI provides qualification and product-guidance tools. Final technical suitability, availability, pricing and commercial commitments remain with the relevant business and its specialists.
